depth_definitions.conceptual: Qualitative or theoretical statement without an executable persistent update.
depth_definitions.external_optimization: A fixed optimizer improves an external target.
depth_definitions.adaptation: The system learns or searches for current or future tasks under a fixed update procedure.
depth_definitions.persistent: A versioned modification survives into later tasks.
depth_definitions.transfer: A persistent modification is reported to improve untouched tasks, models, or environments.
depth_definitions.multi_generation: Several successor generations or lineage steps are reported.
depth_definitions.one_round_coevolution: Model–harness interaction is demonstrated for one full build/update/rebuild round.
depth_definitions.recursive_theory: A formal result concerns improvement of the self-modifying procedure.
depth_definitions.evaluation: The work primarily evaluates, audits, or bounds self-improvement claims.

evidence_definitions.reported: Stated by the original authors or repository.
evidence_definitions.reproduced: Public artifacts were rerun with materially matching results.
evidence_definitions.replicated: An independent implementation supports the same conclusion.
evidence_definitions.contradicted: A controlled result conflicts with the claim.
evidence_definitions.open: Available evidence does not decide the claim.
